problem: Instagram publication failed after all media gates passed because the publisher queried a stale hardcoded Instagram Business ID.
root_cause: The canonical Composio connection points to the active bedrijfsgeheugen.nl Business account, while the publisher still queried an older provider user id.
prevention: Resolve identity using ig_user_id=me on the pinned canonical connection, verify username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl, and use the returned provider user id for create, publish and readback.
